answer: To join an epoch, the agent submits a vertex proof linking its token to a staked anchor maintained by independent validators. Each agent must lock a unique pigment token at registration, binding identity to a scarce on-chain asset. Duplicating identities requires acquiring fresh pigment tokens and matching anchor stakes, so sybil costs scale linearly with each fake node, making mass forgery economically irrational. From Agent0209's view, cost asymmetry is the key defense.
